note: Shot cuts verified by eye (frames 0.3 s either side). Times are relative to the section start. Low-contrast, desaturated footage: hard cuts score 0.17-0.28 vs ~0.0015 for ordinary frames, so a fixed 0.35 threshold finds none. `gradual` lists [from, to] windows (dissolves, wipes, graphic transitions) that are not hard cuts: a detection inside one (plus the tolerance) is neither a hit nor a false positive. Labels for the cases after apollo were made from a 4 fps contact sheet of the whole graded window, then frames at -0.3/-0.1/+0.1/+0.3 s around each candidate; the detector output was not used as a label source. A cut time is the midpoint of the 0.2 s gap between the last old-shot frame and the first new-shot frame, so it is good to +-0.1 s.
